topic: Best use of a mind: descent, not display
quote:
the best use of a mind is not display but *descent*. When a mountain
will not yield, you prove the foothill

salon: FERMAT_RACTOR_20260906.md (inaugural operator conversation — not a salon/panel)
topic: Why he did not publish: the margin belongs to the reader
quote:
I wanted mine to belong to the margin —
the one place in a book where a reader may disagree with the author in ink.

topic: Did he possess the proof? Neighboring, not possessing
quote:
I do not
remember possessing the proof. I remember *neighboring* it.
